title: The Well-Tempered Clavier, Book 2, Fugue 8 in D-sharp minor

character.text: Free, rhetorical fugue in the manner of a Froberger capriccio

sections.label: Episode 1
sections.summary: Reworks the codetta (bars 5–6) in part, with the alto's line in the tenor, the tenor's line in the bass, transposed. Soprano: free counterpoint. Alto: free counterpoint. Tenor: a figure from the subject. Bass: a figure from the subject.

sections.label: Link
sections.summary: Free counterpoint: nothing here is traced to the themes.

Link
sections.summary: Alto: free counterpoint. Tenor: free counterpoint. Bass: a figure from the subject. Returns in Episode 2 (bars 34–40).

sections.summary: Free counterpoint: nothing here is traced to the themes.

sections.label: Episode 2
sections.summary: Reworks Link (bar 27) in part, with the alto's line in the tenor, the tenor's line in the soprano, at the same pitch level. Soprano: a figure from the subject, in a sequence rising by a fifth every bar. Alto: a figure from the subject. Tenor: a figure from the subject (2 times), in a sequence rising by a fifth every bar. Bass: free counterpoint.
